description: Unsigned transactions to sell covered same-day options from the wallet: lock the collateral (one share of the stock for each call, the strike in USDG for each put; exact approval), make the option tokens, and put them on sale at a price in USDG each. The seller is paid as buyers take them, less Borro's share. With held: true it puts option tokens the wallet already holds on sale instead and locks nothing. The whole lock is posted, so nothing can be liquidated; after the close the lock comes back less what the sold options are owed.

held.description: Sell option tokens already in the wallet instead of making new ones

options.description: Options to sell (at least 0.001; one option is on one share), as a decimal string, like "1.5"

price.description: The price you ask for one option, USDG, as a decimal string, like "1.5"

series_id.description: The series id instead of type and strike (options_0dte and position list them)

strike.description: The strike in dollars, like "165" (options_0dte gives the step)

symbol.description: A stock with same-day options, by its ticker, like NVDA

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: sell_0dte
title: Prepare: sell covered same-day options
